title: Ordinary Human follow-up: expose accepted startup failure to its parent
outcome: A Human follow-up accepted before provider startup failure remains visibly recoverable to its parent without falsely reporting delivery or losing the original queued envelope.
acceptance: A deterministic accepted Human follow-up startup failure has an explicit parent-visible disposition and a supported recovery action, preserving the original queued id and content.
A regression covers parent wait/status and the chosen recovery or failed-follow-up lifecycle; review and required validation are recorded.
